mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium as investors anticipate future rate hikes, pushing S&P 500 forward returns positive over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: Over a 12-month window, 20-day forward returns do not outperform a 5-day rolling average during preceding high-inflation months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly PAYEMS labor cost growth above 0.5% for two consecutive months signals wage pressures that boost consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases for two consecutive months and exceeds 0.5% in the second month
failure_condition: In regimes with rising unemployment, the 60-day forward return is not statistically higher than the 20-day return (Granger causality rejected, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in monthly INDPRO manufacturing index below 50 (indicating supply-side weakness) coincides with a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as market anticipates sector rotation.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 50 in the current month
failure_condition: During confirmed supply disruptions, the 5-day forward return is not significantly different from the prior 5-day average (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in HOUST retail sales exceeding 2% for three consecutive months indicates resilient consumer demand, which elevates S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases for three consecutive months and current increase > 2%
failure_condition: During high uncertainty regimes (e.g., geopolitical shock), the 20-day forward return does not exceed the 5-day average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 1% for two consecutive months during a low unemployment regime, the persistent accommodative stance is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% for two consecutive months and Unemployment < 4% (proxy: UNRATE)
failure_condition: In high-inflation regimes, the 60-day forward return is not statistically superior to a neutral policy regime (Granger causality rejected, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE unemployment rate to below 4% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days as labor market tightening is interpreted as a growth signal.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 4% in the current month
failure_condition: During high inflation periods, the 20-day forward return does not beat the prior 5-day average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A double-dip decline in monthly RSAFS industrial production below 100 (after a prior recovery) suggests renewed supply-side weakness and predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls below 100 for two consecutive months after an upward turn
failure_condition: During normal macro conditions, the 5-day forward return is not significantly negative (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% in a single month during a high-inflation regime, the market anticipates tighter policy and S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by > 0.25% in the current month and CPIAUCSL > 0.4%
failure_condition: In deflationary regimes, the 20-day forward return is not negatively predicted (p > 0.05).
